title: Add price per liter to fill-ups (input, storage, and display)

requirements.text: Extend the fill-up data model to store a total fuel cost value per fill-up so that price per liter can be derived.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend `FillUp` records include a new numeric field representing total fuel cost for that fill-up.
The `addFillUp` backend method accepts the new cost parameter and persists it with the fill-up entry.
Existing stored fill-ups (created before this change) remain readable without trapping; missing cost values are handled safely (e.g., treated as absent/optional).

requirements.text: Update the fill-up creation flow UI to capture total fuel cost and submit it alongside odometer and fuel added, while keeping user-facing text in English.
acceptanceCriteria: `Record Fill-Up` form includes a new numeric input labeled "Total cost" (English) and validates it as a non-negative number when provided (or required if the implementation chooses to require it).
On submit, the frontend sends the cost value to the backend together with odometer and fuel added (using the same unit conversion approach already used for odometer/fuel).
If the backend rejects the request, the existing toast-based error handling continues to show an English error message.

requirements.text: Compute and display "Price per liter" for each fill-up entry in the Fill-Up History list based on stored total cost divided by stored liters, with sensible formatting and graceful fallback when cost is missing.
acceptanceCriteria: Fill-up entries in the history list display a new field labeled "Price per liter" when total cost is available for that entry.
Displayed price per liter is computed as (totalCost / fuelAddedInLiters) and formatted to a readable fixed decimal format.
For fill-ups without a stored cost value, the UI does not break and shows an English fallback (e.g., "N/A") or hides the field consistently.

constraints: Respect the single-actor backend architecture; keep Motoko logic in `backend/main.mo`.
Do not edit any files under `frontend/src/components/ui` or other immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
nonGoals: Do not add third-party payments, currency conversion, or external pricing APIs.
Do not add new authentication providers (Internet Identity only).
Do not redesign unrelated dashboard components beyond what is necessary to capture and display price per liter.
